title: spec+server: an ownership queue primitive (queue entity, membership, claim) and declarative assignment rules, so an app routes ownerless records without app-level round-robin (maintainer ruling D6 = A)
body:
Ruled: 6457475657 · letter A (queues reserved key) · 2026-10-28T00:43Z

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed. Tesla ruled the whole-project assessment's D6 on 2026-10-25 09:23Z in the director thread, answering "A = queue/assignment rules are a real platform need, file the objectstack card, hotcrm deletes its STOPGAP after it lands; B = it is legitimate app logic": 「D4 · 固定发版日 没必要；其他同意 ，npm dist-tag 手工清理 应该立一张管理者维护的卡」 — "其他同意" read as A, the recommendation; the director thread said so back to Tesla at 09:25Z. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route. New protocol surface: the contract shape is Tesla's to approve in the PR (Tier H through the ADR it adds).

Governing text: `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` on the deprecated `queue` approver type — "Re-admit only together with a real ownership-queue implementation (queue entity + membership + claim)"; `packages/spec/src/security/sharing.zod.ts` — "the runtime contract additionally reserves `queue` (no `sys_queue` yet) — it is deliberately NOT authorable until the implementation lands". hotcrm `AGENTS.md` rules 1–2 (platform gaps are filed upstream, never compensated in the app).

## Who needs it today (the pull)

- hotcrm `src/service/objects/_case-assignment.ts` (587 lines) opens with "⛔ This module is a STOPGAP. It is the code to delete": a web-to-case submission has its `owner_id` stripped and "has nowhere to sit", so the app substitutes a least-loaded round-robin over a position pool, and has to route around the ownership-transfer gate to do it. `lead_auto_assign` in `src/sales/objects/lead.hook.ts` does the same for inbound leads (`src/sales/flows/lead-assignment.flow.ts`).
- The reference app is the corpus AI copies most; today it teaches "write a hook that counts rows to pick an owner" while its own rules say never compensate. Lead and case routing is a standard need of any CRM-shaped app built on the platform.

## What lands (one PR, spec key with its first reader — ruling D5)

- spec: the queue entity, its membership (users / positions / teams, using existing recipient kinds), and a declarative assignment rule (criteria → queue or user, with round-robin / least-loaded as named strategies). Re-admit the deprecated `queue` approver type and the reserved `queue` sharing recipient once they are enforced.
- server: the system object(s), the claim operation (an agent takes a record from a queue; ownership transfer through the existing gate, not around it), the assignment-rule evaluation on insert, and the approvals / sharing branches the two deprecated members were waiting for.
- A shape proposal comes first in the PR's 维护者速读 (Chinese, business view) with the ADR; the dev reports a fork if the shape needs a choice the governing text above does not settle.
- Downstream: the hotcrm card that deletes the STOPGAP is filed alongside and blocked on this one; it unblocks when a published `@objectstack/*` release carries this, not at merge.

Readers: triage (route; likely domain:spec seam with server), then the claiming seat. Effort guess L, cross-package (spec, objectql/plugin-security/plugin-sharing/plugin-approvals): the risk / effort floor applies, which Tesla's ruling covers for direction; shape and naming stay with the PR review.

Duplicate check: semantic searches "queue assignment rule primitive round robin owner assignment lead case" (objectstack, 0 hits) and "case assignment STOPGAP sys_queue lead auto assign" (hotcrm, 1 closed unrelated: #507). No duplicate.
